_comment: The remaining work as 4 Kaggle notebooks. Each section is one former notebook (notebooks/src), run in order as its own process by asd_lib/asd_runner.py. 'after' = sections of the same notebook that must finish first. D1 (asd-xmf-d1-photo-dataset) already ran in full and stays a separate input. 'rev' (default 1): raise a section's rev to re-run it (and what needs it) while finished sections are reused; raise the notebook's rev (and the same item's rev in tools/queue.json) so the queue runs it again.

notebooks.title: ASD-XMF X1 Datasets Benchmarks
notebooks.about: Stage 1 datasets D2-D4, then the audio, video and text sector comparisons (A1, V1, T1).

notebooks.title: ASD-XMF X2 Photo Gaze
notebooks.about: Photo sector comparison P1 on D1 (proposed XMF-Face vs 11 baselines) and the gaze study NB13.

notebooks.title: ASD-XMF X3 Cohort Pipeline
notebooks.about: Cohort audit and splits, face and audio pipelines, frame embeddings and all single-modality baselines (NB00-NB07).

notebooks.title: ASD-XMF X4 Fusion Report
notebooks.about: XMF fusion vs 6 fusion baselines, ablations and shortcut tests, XAI, statistics and figures, app export (NB08-NB12).
